text:
maria.t: FYI found a reproducible failure on RHEL9 with SELinux=Enforcing + systemd PrivateTmp — HSM PKCS#11 plugin can't open its socket. Raising a docs PR with repro and a suggested systemd override: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4590

kenji: ugh. can you paste the AVC denial from audit.log so we know the exact obj/context?

maria.t: sure — here's the key AV C snippet I captured:

`May 02 12:34:56 host audit[1234]: AVC avc:  denied  { open } for  pid=1234 comm="redwood-hsm-plugin" name="pkey" dev=tmpfs ino=12345 scontext=system_u:system_r:redwood_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:tmp_t:s0 tclass=file permissive=0`

maria.t: TL;DR: plugin creates socket under /tmp (PrivateTmp) -> gets tmp_t label -> redwood process context redwood_t cannot open tmp_t files.

prashant: interesting. two obvious options for docs: 1) recommend disabling PrivateTmp for the hsm plugin unit, 2) recommend using a fixed path under /var/lib/redwood/hsm with a proper file context (and provide restorecon). i'd prefer #2 as it preserves PrivateTmp security.

olivia: agree w/ @prashant. we should show a minimal systemd override + an selinux chcon/restorecon example. also add note for air-gapped installs where running restorecon is manual.

maria.t: draft override I put in the PR (feel free to paste into docs):

```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-hsm.service.d/10-selinux.conf
[Service]
# keep PrivateTmp on, use a fixed socket dir
PrivateTmp=yes
RuntimeDirectory=redwood-hsm
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket
ExecStartPre=/sbin/restorecon -R -v /var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket || true
# plugin will bind to /var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket/pkcs11.sock
```

kenji: nice. also include the `semanage fcontext -a -t redwood_var_t '/var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket(/.*)?'` line for systems with semanage present. and fallback with `chcon` if not.

prashant: suggestion for wording in docs: "Preferred: create a persistent socket directory with correct SELinux file context and run restorecon at install time. If you cannot modify file contexts, you may disable PrivateTmp as a last resort." Keep exact commands in a collapsible code block.

olivia: I'll add a short migration subsection: "Upgrading existing on-prem installs" with a small script to detect old installs using /tmp and migrate the socket path and fix contexts. script snippet in PR.

maria.t: posted the initial PR with examples and a short repro script: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4590 — please review.

docs-bot: Link-check: failed — external link to `https://semanage.example/` is 404 in PR 4590, removing that placeholder might fix CI.

kenji: I pushed a tiny edit to the PR replacing that placeholder with the correct semanage man link: https://linux.die.net/man/8/semanage

maria.t: thanks — can we also add a one-line note in the Private Deployment Troubleshooting FAQ that mentions SELinux+PrivateTmp socket issues? short bullet + pointer to the new section.

prashant: +1. once CI passes and someone from security approves the SELinux wording, we can merge. cc @olivia for final copyedit.

olivia: will do copyedit this afternoon. then :shipit: if tests pass.

maria.t: awesome, thanks team. leaving the thread open for any last edge-cases (asan/arm64 testers pls try the repro).
